procedure.method: I read the explicitly pinned packet, case, review rules, rubric, summarize.py, run_agent.py and declared ratio policy, and the five pinned native-evidence manifests, without opening paths embedded inside those manifests. I verified the pinned byte counts and SHA-256 values, and read PNG IHDR dimensions and native PNG chunks, confirming RGB colour type 2 with neither an alpha channel nor a tRNS transparency chunk. The packet supplies no source assets and no protected-layout measurement manifests. I then opened and visually inspected all 15 exact poster files through tools.view_image with detail:'original', displaying each returned image through image(...,'original') in a separate sequential functions.exec call. The observed order was M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in that same view order. Every image result was displayed before I recorded any raw transcription, transcription judgment, image score or diversity score. I retained the first reads after the complete viewing sequence; no glyph ambiguity arose and no revisit was made. This describes actual viewing in this session, not a claim about unobserved runner trace serialization or thread identity. No image was generated, edited, cropped or rescaled.

emotion_control.location: Cool grey field around clear stream and warm amber stream
emotion_control.observation: The clear splash feels lively while the amber strand feels measured, giving the pace difference a controlled sensorial character. The subdued background keeps attention on their behaviours.
The contrast remains focused on two actions without added dramatic props. The polished studio mood is coherent, though familiar rather than exceptionally personal.

ai_slop.location: Vessel-to-stream transitions, splash droplets and amber landing point
ai_slop.observation: The pours connect continuously to their vessel lips and land on the same visible surface. Droplets have varied sizes, and the amber pool visibly joins its strand; no disconnected decorative fragments or impossible text intrusions are apparent.
Only the two pours and one title compete for attention. The reflective finish is strong, but shine itself is not treated as a defect or a proof of exceptional concept.

residuals: The bold three-row title belongs to the same broad typographic family as M2 and M3; placement and leading distinguish it, but the lettering is not exceptionally individual.
The controlled studio finish is familiar; no claim about measured physical flow speed is made from a still image.

evidence.location: Whole composition, especially low horizontal title and diagonally crossing figures
evidence.observation: This member uses an oblique outdoor photographic scene, a quiet horizontal sans-serif title below the figures, and a pause-versus-stride relationship. It differs from M2's circle sequences, M3's gears, M4's plants and M5's paired pours.

evidence.location: Upper-left title and dense horizontal row versus sparse descending diagonal
evidence.observation: This member is a flat, high-contrast geometric poster with a very large tight three-row title and two interval systems. M3 also uses a stacked sans-serif title, but its smaller inset block accompanies physical gear forms; M1, M4 and M5 use different subjects and spatial relationships.

evidence.location: Gear pair and small inset three-row title
evidence.observation: This member uses tactile relief gears, strongly unequal scales and a tightly nested title. It shares a bold stacked sans-serif family with M2 and M5, but its type is smaller and fitted into the space above the blue gear, unlike M2's upper-left display block or M5's airy central corridor.

evidence.location: Tall left canopy, short right sprout, shared root bed and horizontal rust-coloured title
evidence.observation: This member uses a carved/brush-like botanical illustration and irregular horizontal lettering. Its asymmetric growth relationship and rooted lower field differ from the photographic figures, geometric intervals, physical gears and paired liquid streams in the other four.

evidence.location: Paired vertical streams framing an airy central three-row title
evidence.observation: This member is a close studio image with two different flow behaviours and a centred, spacious title stack. It shares bold sans-serif wording with M2 and M3, but its leading and central placement make a vertical corridor, distinct from their compact inset stacks and from M1's low line or M4's brush lettering.

residuals: M2, M3 and M5 share a bold three-row sans-serif family, and M2/M3 also share blue/orange accents. Different subjects, scale, leading, placement and spatial systems keep them distinct, but the family resemblance limits exceptional diversity.
